content.title: When and What Time Does ‘BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang’ Stream on Netflix
content.text: BTS is officially back and set to take the stage for the first time in years. The superstar group are celebrating the release of their new album, “Arirang,” out now, with a special live concert from the historic Gwanghwamun in Seoul.Airing on Netflix, “BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang” will have BTS members RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook make their highly anticipated return after they took a break to complete their military services. BTS fans, known as Army, have been anxiously waiting to see the seven singers perform live — and in just a few hours they will get to.However, a day before the reunion concert, BigHit Music announced that RM suffered an ankle injury “and was taken to a hospital to undergo a detailed examination and treatment.” The singer is expected to be on stage but his choreography “will be partially limited,” the statement reads. The concert is just the start of the group’s comeback. The promotion for their album includes an appearance in New York on March 23 for a special Spotify event. They will also be on “The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon” on March 25 and 26.Additionally, Netflix will drop their documentary, “BTS: The Return,” on March 27. And that's not all: The group will kick off their “BTS World Tour Arirang” on April 9 in South Korea.But first, here is everything you need to know about the BTS concert, “BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang.” When Is ‘BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang’ Happening?“BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang” will take place on Saturday, March 21.Where to Watch ‘BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang’ The reunion concert will stream on Netflix.What Time Will ‘BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang’ Stream?The concert will stream live around the world, and the time depends on where you are located. The BTS concert begins at 8 p.m. Korean Standard Time, 7 a.m. ET and 4 a.m. PT.For those unable to watch it live, the BTS concert will stream on Netflix after. What to Expect During ‘BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang’BTS is expected to perform songs from their new album, “Arirang,” which was released March 20. The group will hopefully also sing some of their major hits, like “Dynamite,” “Permission to Dance,” “Butter,” “Mic Drop” and many more.
